missing_information_behavior: If activity type or goal is missing, do not add positive score; request clarification.
safety_exclusions: Do not infer benefit for endurance-only or low-intensity activity.
Do not recommend creatine to treat a medical condition.
Kidney disease, pregnancy, adolescence, medication use or abnormal renal tests require professional review.
professional_escalation_conditions: Known kidney disease or reduced renal function.
Pregnancy, breastfeeding, minors, or relevant chronic disease.
Use of nephrotoxic medication or unexplained abnormal renal markers.
population_and_context: Adults undertaking strength, power or repeated high-intensity exercise with a strength/muscle goal; exercise context alone is not a medical indication.
dose_constraints: This rule only contributes a relevance score; dose must come from a separately reviewed ingredient record and must not be inferred from this rule.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS exercise fact sheet is a secondary government synthesis. Evidence for performance outcomes varies by exercise type, protocol and population; assess exact outcome and form before approval. This rule remains draft; source passage extraction, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional approval are required before activation.
